items.q: Make your own picture equation. Choose a number for the circle and a different number for the triangle. Write two lines for a grown-up to solve. Many answers are right.
items.hint: Start with the numbers, then write the totals.
steps: Choose the circle and the triangle.
Write circle + circle + triangle = another total.
Ask a grown-up to find your numbers.
